title: Implement Post Pinning Feature with User-Specific Rate Limiting
description: CliqueCore is a high-performance, C-based backend for a social media application. The platform needs a new feature allowing users to 'pin' a single post, making it appear at the top of their profile feed. This task involves modifying the database, implementing the API endpoint and business logic, and finally adding a rate-limiting mechanism to prevent abuse. The development will be split across three distinct sessions, requiring the agent to retain context and build upon its previous work.

project_spec.name: CliqueCore
project_spec.description:
CliqueCore is a high-performance, C-based social networking platform aimed at tight-knit interest communities that need real-time interaction at massive scale. Built from the ground up with an MVC mentality, the project separates HTTP routing/controllers, domain models, and adaptive views rendered to mobile/desktop browsers, giving developers a clear mental model while still exploiting C’s raw speed. Members can create "Circles", exchange media-rich posts, run live polls, and even monetize premium content through an integrated payment gateway. 

The hard-level specification mandates 57 source files (~294 k tokens) that weave together a REST API layer, a componentized service layer, and a repository abstraction over multiple databases (PostgreSQL + Redis). File uploads, full-text search, and third-party social logins are handled as discrete services, each exposed via well-documented endpoints. SSL/TLS is enforced end-to-end with OpenSSL, sessions are HMAC-signed, and a configurable logging/caching system ensures observability and low-latency responses. An admin panel delivers role-based moderation, analytics, and content governance in a responsive single-page experience, while a background worker subsystem dispatches email notifications, invoice webhooks, and search-index updates without blocking the main event loop.
dependencies: libmicrohttpd – lightweight HTTP server for REST controllers
glib + GObject – object system enabling MVC structuring in C
PostgreSQL client library (libpq) – relational data store
hiredis – Redis client for caching & session storage
liboauth – OAuth 1/2 client for social login providers
libcurl – SMTP/HTTP client used for email notifications & external APIs
libstripe (or stripe-c) – payment processing SDK bindings
uthash/utarray – lightweight hash/array utilities for model repositories
